InputNaming.description: Maps semantic input-name subjects to their expected lexical naming conventions.

Convention.description: Selects the lexical naming convention for this subject.

Prefix.description: Text prepended to the rendered logical name.

TypeMarker.description: Semantic type marker inserted between prefix and rendered logical name.

Suffix.description: Text appended after the rendered logical name.

OutputNaming.description: Maps semantic output-name subjects to target rendering rules.

Source.description: Selects where the input definition version is obtained.

FileNameSeparator.description: Separator between the logical source name and file-name version suffix.

RequirePositiveInteger.description: Requires a discovered definition version to be a positive integer.

RequireMatchingSources.description: Requires explicit and file-name versions to match when both are present.

InputVersionPolicy.description: Controls how the canonical source-definition version is discovered and validated.

IncludeVersion.description: Controls whether the semantic definition version is emitted in generated names.

Separator.description: Separator emitted before the generated version fragment.

Prefix.description: Text prepended to the rendered logical name.

Suffix.description: Text appended after the rendered logical name.

OutputVersionPolicy.description: Controls how the canonical definition version is rendered in generated names.

description: Defines source naming rules, target naming rules, and independent input/output version policies.
